title: Transaction
description: A reported purchase, sale, or exchange affecting a Holding.

owner.description: Who the form marks as holding the asset. unmarked: the ownership column was left blank; the House PTR form makes marking a spouse's, dependent child's or jointly held asset optional, so a blank is not a statement that the asset is the filer's own. spouse, dependent, joint: as marked. self: a source that states the filer's own holding; no current source emits it, and the House PTR cannot. trust, other: as the source states.

filing_status.description: The filing status the report prints beside the row, as printed: New, Amended or Deleted on the House PTR. Null when the report prints none. A row marked Amended or Deleted is carried as filed, with the mark; the e-filed layout prints no separate statement that the report amends another.

notified_date.description: Date the Officeholder was notified of the transaction, where different from transaction_date (per STOCK Act reporting).
